title: Database Foundation
description: Establishes global database configuration, typed schema definitions, and a single migration creating all tables with proper constraints and indexes.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL

types.ts defines Database interface with tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks, comments, attachments, notifications, audit_logs — every table includes tenant_id: string except organizations which does not include tenant_id
Generated<> is used ONLY on: id, created_at, updated_at, is_active, read columns
All nullable columns are typed as string | null
001_initial.ts creates ALL tables with correct columns, CHECK constraints for role/status enums, foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE, and required indexes exactly as defined in SRS
users.email has UNIQUE constraint
Indexes created: idx_users_tenant_id, idx_projects_tenant_id, idx_projects_status, idx_tasks_tenant_id, idx_tasks_project_id, idx_tasks_assigned_to, idx_tasks_status
All tables include created_at DEFAULT now() and updated_at DEFAULT now()
migrate.ts executes all pending migrations using Kysely Migrator
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implements JWT authentication with registration, login, refresh tokens, global guard, and role decorators.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/register is decorated with @Public() and creates organization and first user with role hardcoded to 'Admin'

RegisterDto has email: @IsEmail() @MaxLength(255), password: @IsString() @MinLength(8), first_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(100), last_name: same validation, organization_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(150)
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
Password hashed using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds
Successful register returns 201 with { id, email, first_name, last_name, role: 'Admin', tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/login is decorated with @Public() and returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Invalid credentials throw UnauthorizedException
POST /api/auth/refresh is decorated with @Public() and returns new access_token
JWT payload contains sub, email, role, tenant_id exactly
JwtStrategy validate() returns { id: payload.sub, email, role, tenant_id }
Global guard is registered using APP_GUARD in app.module.ts
@Public() decorator bypasses global guard
@Roles('Admin') decorator sets metadata and RolesGuard enforces exact casing
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Provides organization creation endpoint that creates the organization and its first admin user and returns an access token.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/organizations is decorated with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has organization_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(150), email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name, last_name same validation as register
Endpoint creates organization and user with role 'Admin' and hashes password with bcrypt 12 rounds
Returns 201 with { access_token, user: { id, email, role: 'Admin', tenant_id } }
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped user management with pagination and role-based access control.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users implements pagination with default page=1, limit=20, max limit=100
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
POST /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
CreateUserDto has email, password, first_name, last_name validations and role: @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
Password hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Email must be globally unique or throw ConflictException
POST /api/users returns created user without password_hash
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Implements project creation, listing, and updates with strict tenant enforcement and role-based access.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/projects requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @MinLength(1) @MaxLength(150), description: @IsOptional() @IsString()
Default status is 'Active'
GET /api/projects accessible to all authenticated users
Members only see projects where tasks assigned_to = req.user.id
GET /api/projects implements pagination and returns { data, meta }
PATCH /api/projects/:id requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
UpdateProjectDto status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
Cannot modify project if tenant mismatch — return NotFoundException
All queries filter by tenant_id
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Implements task creation, listing, and updates with project status enforcement and assignment-based permissions.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks requires @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateTaskDto has title: @IsString() @MinLength(1), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), assigned_to: @IsUUID(), status: @IsOptional() @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
Project must have status 'Active' or throw BadRequestException
assigned_to must belong to same tenant or throw BadRequestException
Default status is 'ToDo'
GET /api/tasks accessible to all authenticated users
Members only see tasks where assigned_to = req.user.id
GET /api/tasks implements pagination and returns { data, meta }
PATCH /api/tasks/:id allows Admin, ProjectManager, or assigned Member
Member can update only if task.assigned_to === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
Cannot modify task if its project status is 'Archived'
All queries filter by tenant_id
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provides aggregated dashboard metrics and user-specific notifications with pagination and read tracking.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/dashboard returns { total_projects, total_tasks, completed_tasks, active_users } filtered by tenant_id
GET /api/dashboard accessible to authenticated users
GET /api/notifications implements pagination and returns { data, meta }
Notifications only include records where user_id = req.user.id and tenant_id matches
PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read sets read = true only if notification.user_id === req.user.id else throw ForbiddenException
All queries include tenant_id filter
DashboardController and NotificationsController have NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implements tenant-scoped audit logging and retrieval endpoint restricted to Admin users.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/audit-logs requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs implements pagination and returns { data, meta }
Audit logs filtered strictly by tenant_id
Each audit log record includes id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id, created_at
AuditLogsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditLogsModule is added to app.module.ts imports
